aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:868.title: Manager Maintenance - River Park
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:868.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! A Brief Overview The Manager Maintenance is responsible for ensuring the functionality of the venue prior, during, and after concerts and events. The Manager Maintenance will perform various maintenance tasks such as painting, plumbing, electrical, heating/ air conditioning systems or construction tasks as they arise to make sure the venue is looking and functioning to its best potential. This individual will oversee daily, weekly, monthly scheduled cleaning and maintenance projects, and will assess venue needs on an ongoing basis. Job Summary Oversee daily, event and regularly scheduled cleaning and maintenance projects. Responsible for the overall maintenance of the venue, including: carpet repair/cleaning, painting of interior/exterior, elevator repair, restoration of seats, bathroom maintenance, upkeep of air-conditioning and heating, electrical and plumbing work, other repairs/maintenance as needed. Expert at various cleaning and repair tools with the ability to train others on how to properly utilize. Supervise cleaning team and bathroom attendants attendance, performance, and training needs. Develop standard procedures for maintaining the cleanliness and upkeep of venue and all associated assets. Enforce department and company policies and procedures with staff. Implement disciplinary action and conduct employee reviews. Coordinate with outside vendors on repair and maintenance work. Request quotes/bids to determine best option. May be responsible for the building of set props and decorations and assisting with advancement of production as needed. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) In a related field 4-6 years Of related work experience Working as a maintenance manager in related industry In proper cleaning solutions and overall repair/maintenance Ability to prioritize workload, solve problems quickly and react to difficult situations appropriately Ability to read, listen and communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing Knowledge of HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical repair Highly organized with good coordinating and project management skills Able to meet tight deadlines and work effectively in a high-pressure environment Must be able to work flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and some holidays Knowledge of music industry preferred Payscale: $59,564.55- $85,000.00 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager Spain (m/f/d)
aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.description: Are you ready to scale a market leader? As our (Senior) Customer Success Manager for Spain, you will be the strategic anchor for our expansion, focusing heavily on senior stakeholder management and end-to-end project management. You will navigate complex client landscapes, align C-level expectations, and execute the flawless rollout of our innovative payment platform across major Spanish car dealership groups. Your mission - Stakeholder management: Serve as the primary, high-level liaison and trusted advisor for our Spanish customer portfolio - Project management: Drive the end-to-end implementation of our innovative payment process platform from kickoff to final rollout - Risk mitigation: Identify onboarding bottlenecks proactively and resolve them cross-functionally through rigorous project tracking - Training leadership: Lead comprehensive education sessions both remotely and on-site to ensure seamless product adoption by operational managers - Account expansion: Upgrade existing clients to advanced feature sets by continuously demonstrating long-term strategic value - Product alignment: Translate direct customer feedback into actionable project requirements for our internal product and engineering teams Your profile - Project expertise: Minimum 5 years of digital multi-project management, ideally backed by a proven track record of complex software implementations - Stakeholder skills: Executive presence that allows you to confidently manage, navigate, and negotiate at C-level, even in tense situations - Hard skills: Advanced background in FinTech, digital payment solutions, or the automotive SaaS environment - Workflow management: Structured working style with the ability to orchestrate multiple enterprise-level projects simultaneously under pressure - Languages & mobility: Native or bilingual Spanish language skills combined with business-fluent English and a strong willingness to travel Why us? - Growth journey: Impactful opportunity to be part of one of the most exciting and fastest-growing FinTech scale-ups in Europe - Development: Extensive training budgets and tailored career advancement opportunities to constantly improve your skills - Culture: Open and transparent corporate environment that actively encourages flat hierarchies and the realization of your own ideas - Flexibility: Modern working models with the possibility to work from home and balance your professional life - Team spirit: Vibrant community fostered by regular monthly team events, celebrations, and shared fun About us We, Aufinity, are a Cologne-based FinTech Scaleup and pioneer for digital payment solutions in the automotive sector. In 2018, we created bezahl.de http://bezahl.de, the first all-in-one platform for digital payment management in the automotive trade. With our product, we optimize internal payment processes and help our customers save valuable time and costs in the back office. At the same time, we enable car dealership groups to offer a fully digital payment process with various payment methods - including specialized payment methods for large sums - for the first time.

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Axiom, a global leader in alternative legal services, is working with a well‑respected university that is seeking a Legal Counsel to sit within the legal team as a service‑focused first point of contact, supporting senior counsel to deliver timely, high‑quality advice across employment, disputes, complaints, and investigations. The role also provides legal oversight of complex investigations involving students, staff, and third parties, particularly where serious misconduct and elevated legal risk are involved. Responsibilities : Act as a service-focused, proactive point of contact for internal clients and external parties across people/HR, workplace relations, student conduct and dispute matters, and other portfolios as required. Provide legal and strategic advice on staff and student disputes, including negotiation, mediation, resolution strategies, and management of court and tribunal proceedings (including briefing and managing external counsel). Build and maintain productive working relationships with key stakeholders and their teams, and deliver business-focused legal training on contemporary issues relevant to them. Develop, maintain and enhance template documents and legal resources, and prepare regular legal updates for internal communication channels. Manage the use of external legal advisers where appropriate, and ensure work is carried out in line with relevant organisational policies and procedures. Requirements: Substantial experience as a lawyer in workplace relations (employment, industrial relations, safety, discrimination) and administrative law; higher education sector experience (in-house or private practice) is highly desirable. Proven ability to deliver timely, business-relevant legal advice, working collaboratively with multiple stakeholders at different levels. Demonstrated capacity to operate with a high level of confidentiality, diplomacy, and influence, supported by excellent interpersonal and time management skills. Able to work autonomously in a fast-paced team environment, bringing a positive, can-do attitude. Why Join Axiom? World-class clients – our global presence provides direct access to opportunities with premier companies, including F100 and ASX-listed organisations, allowing you to roadmap your career with exciting and challenging work. Flexibility – we work with you to achieve the highest level of flexibility – in the way that you define it. Whether you prefer remote work, a greater breadth of exposure, or even more personal time – we match you with opportunities to help you reach these goals. A dedicated talent team – we put in the effort to make sure your experience is nothing short of exceptional, by assigning you a dedicated talent partner that oversees your journey with us from when you join Axiom, to starting your first engagement, and all future engagements! Referral bonus – once you start working with us, refer your legal peers and enjoy a generous referral bonus as a thank you for expanding the Axiom community! Not convinced? Click here to read about our lawyer experiences and find out more about becoming an Axiomite! For more information, please contact sarah.carlin@axiomlaw.com . Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about working at Axiom. Equal Opportunity Employer:

brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:83bbdf8a-8352-4c2c-8.title: Principal FPGA Engineer
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:83bbdf8a-8352-4c2c-8.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE: We are seeking a Principal FPGA Engineer to lead the design and development of advanced FPGA-based systems for our autonomous drones and public safety products. In this role, you will architect and implement high-performance video pipelines, sensor interfaces, and real-time processing systems to enable robust perception and data handling. As a technical leader, you will drive innovation, mentor engineers, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver cutting-edge hardware acceleration and digital systems that enable real-world live-savings robotic devices in demanding environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of FPGA systems for video, sensor, and communication pipelines. - Develop and optimize logic for high-speed digital interfaces such as MIPI CSI/DSI, LVDS, HDMI, PCIe, and Gigabit Ethernet. - Implement memory controllers, DMA engines, and streaming architectures to support real-time data transfer. - Optimize FPGA designs for performance, power efficiency, and resource utilization. - Collaborate with hardware, software, and systems teams to ensure seamless FPGA integration into embedded platforms. - Implement FPGA acceleration for real-time image signal processing (ISP) and video enhancement pipelines. QUALIFICATIONS: - Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - 7+ years of FPGA design and development experience in complex systems. - Expert proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and/or SystemVerilog. - Strong background with FPGA vendor tools such as Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus, and ModelSim/QuestaSim. - Experience with Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale+ or similar SoC/FPGA chipsets. - Proven ability in high-speed digital design, timing closure, and FPGA resource optimization. - Hands-on experience with board-level bring-up, lab instrumentation, and debugging complex FPGA systems. PREFERRED SKILLS: - 10+ years of FPGA design and development experience in complex systems. - Familiarity with video/image signal processing hardware implementation. - Familiarity with computer vision and perception algorithms and their hardware acceleration on FPGA. - Experience optimizing video and sensor processing chains for low latency in autonomous systems. - Experience with embedded processor integration (e.g. ARM cores, MicroBlaze, Nios II, or RISC-V). - Experience with OpenGL. General experience with hardware acceleration of algorithms on modern GPU architectures. - Knowledge of DDR memory systems, SERDES, and multi-gigabit transceivers. - Experience developing FPGA systems for aerospace, defense, or safety-critical applications. - Track record of leading technical projects and mentoring engineering teams. BRINC CULTURE VALUES: - Try the hard stuff - Be innovative - Invent the future - Move fast - Listen to end-users - Strive for excellence - Don’t build a dystopia - Be frugal - Save lives through technology If you’re interested in this role and in joining BRINC, we hope you’ll apply. We’d love to review your application and get to know more about you! BRINC is proud to be an equal opportunity empl

councilcapital-council-capital:ashbyhq:3.description: Council Capital is a healthcare-focused private equity firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, managing over $350 million in committed capital. We invest in lower middle market healthcare companies where we see the potential to scale purpose and performance. Our investments span control and minority positions in businesses with enterprise values between $10 million and $100 million. What sets us apart is the Council Model—a proven framework that surrounds founders and leadership teams with a powerful combination of support: our CEO Council of seasoned operators, our Strategic Healthcare Investors who bring real-world insight and access, and our internal Value Creation Team, focused on enabling growth through talent, systems, and strategy. At Council Capital, we’re not just backing companies—we’re helping build enduring businesses that improve lives and shape the future of healthcare. Health plans hire us for the technical work behind their most challenging claims issues: claims system conversions, platform modernization, data work, and the project and program talent needed to achieve results. Our clients are payers, and our credibility is built on experience, not just talk. This is a new role. Until now, sales have been handled by the founders and leaders with other primary responsibilities, yet the business has continued to grow. We are hiring the first dedicated sales professional for our services side so growth won’t depend solely on executives who are also running the company. You will be responsible for generating new business from the ground up. You’ll have access to a real market, an established reputation for delivery, and a leadership team with direct experience selling these services, ready to help you with pricing and positioning. You won’t get a lead list, a proposal desk, or a large support team. This is a builder role with real autonomy. What You Will Own - New logo revenue for payer technology services. You will be responsible for net new services business, closing deals from first outreach through signed agreements. - Pipeline creation. In your first six months, build a qualified pipeline that is a multiple of your annual target, measured by live meetings held and proposals delivered—not just by names in a CRM. - Full-cycle sales execution, including prospecting, lead generation, discovery, value proposition development, proposal writing, pricing conversations, and closing. You will involve delivery leaders and subject matter experts at the right moments and manage proposals yourself. - A deal mix that reflects how our business operates: tactical engagements that can close in weeks, as well as fixed-price projects with longer sales cycles. - Activity from week one. Start outreach, make calls, and set meetings in your first days, while you deepen your knowledge of our services. Who Thrives in This Role - A true hunter who enjoys opening cold accounts; outbound work is not something you delegate. - Well-versed in the payer domain, able to contribute meaningfully from the first meeting. You understand health plan needs, decision-makers, and blockers. - A commercially creative thinker able to find new approaches to challenging accounts. Health plans are busy and typically have existing vendors—a new script won’t suffice, but a better idea will. - Someone with a credible executive presence, welcomed by clients at conferences, on-site visits, and in boardroom-level discussions. - A relationship builder whose network is based on trust, reliability, and delivering practical value. Clients answer your calls. - A direct communicator who advances opportunities and asks for the close, while respecting delivery partners. - A resilient operator who candidly explains misses, quickly adjusts, and maintains momentum through challenging services sales cycles. - High tolerance for the challenges of a difficult sell and low tolerance for mediocrity. You persist regardless of obstacles. What You Bring - Five or more years in a closing

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Director, Pharmacology
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients through looking at and treating disease in a revolutionary way. What this position is all about : What if you could join a fast-moving research organization and help shape translational strategy across a growing preclinical pipeline? Cellarity is seeking a highly strategic Sr. Director, Pharmacology to connect biology, pharmacology, DMPK, and translational science across inflammation and hematology programs. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Lab Science, this role will partner closely with biology, chemistry, DMPK, toxicology, external CROs, and scientific leadership to drive programs from early discovery through candidate selection. What you would be responsible for: Lead preclinical pharmacology strategy across multiple discovery programs, with a focus on translating in vitro biology and functional assay data into meaningful in vivo outcomes. Drive PK/PD interpretation, exposure-response assessment, target coverage analysis, and translational biomarker strategy to inform program decisions. Integrate data across biology, pharmacology, medicinal chemistry, and DMPK to build clear scientific narratives and guide candidate advancement. Oversee outsourced pharmacology studies and manage external CRO relationships to ensure studies are scientifically rigorous, well interpreted, and aligned to program objectives. Partner with internal scientific teams to define critical experiments, interpret data packages, and determine what additional studies are needed to advance programs with confidence. Provide strategic input to cross-functional program discussions from early discovery through candidate selection. Represent pharmacology at internal scientific and program meetings, communicating findings, risks, and recommendations with clarity and precision. Contribute to the development of broader translational approaches as the organization continues to expand its preclinical pipeline. What experiences will you need: PhD in biology, pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline, with 10-15+ years of relevant experience in biotech or pharmaceutical drug discovery and development. Strong foundation in preclinical pharmacology with demonstrated experience translating biology into in vivo efficacy and PK/PD insight. Experience connecting in vitro findings to in-vivo outcomes, including target engagement, exposure-response relationships, and translational biomarker strategy. Exposure to DMPK and ability to partner effectively with DMPK scientists on program interpretation and advancement. Proven track record of working across biology, chemistry, pharmacology, and external collaborators to influence drug discovery strategy. Experience managing and interpreting outsourced pharmacology studies through CROs. Strong scientific judgment, data integration skills, and the ability to build decision-enabling narratives from diverse datasets. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence scientific teams and leadership in a matrixed environment. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative research environment with broad program visibility. What will set you apart: Experience in hematology, particularly in combination with oncology. Experience supporting inflammation or immunology programs. Strong publication record spanning pharmacology, translational biology, medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, or drug discovery. Experience working in smaller, cross-functional biotech environments. Demonstrated ability to grow into broader translational leadership over time. Company Summary: Cellarity’s mission is to fundamentally redesign the way drugs are created for the sake of bringing new hope to patients. infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.title: Financial Analyst - Infinity Constellation
infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: FINANCIAL ANALYST Reports to: Head of Finance Location: Remote (Quarterly travel for offsites) ABOUT INFINITY CONSTELLATION Infinity Constellation is the first AI services holding company, building category leaders designed to displace incumbents in the $9T+ professional services market. We give exceptional operators a 12-month head start—backed by capital, shared infrastructure, customers, back-office support, and shared equity—to launch outcome-driven businesses that redefine their industries. THE ROLE We are seeking a high-agency Financial Analyst to partner directly with Founder-CEOs across our Business Units. This role owns budgeting, forecasting, modeling, and performance analytics. You will serve as the finance partner to BU founders and leaders — helping them plan, scale, and operate efficiently. This is a highly cross-functional, strategic role. You will report to the Head of Finance. WHAT YOU’LL OWN BUDGETING & FORECASTING - Design and coordinate annual planning processes with BUs - Maintain rolling forecasts, budget vs actual commentary, margin analysis, and various adhoc analysis as needed - Run quarterly operating plan re-forecast calibrations, and champion BU internal needs FOUNDER PARTNERSHIP - Serve as finance partner to Business Units - Support hiring plan modeling (in partnership with Talent/HR) - Translate financial performance into actionable insights - Help Business Unit teams determine opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs in a principled and structured way FINANCIAL MODELING - Design and build operating models for new and existing BUs - Support investment allocation decisions - Scenario modeling for growth planning PERFORMANCE REPORTING - Develop dashboards and KPI tracking for internal Business Units and the consolidated Constellation team - Build scalable and standardized reporting across BUs - Drive data-driven decision-making AI & AUTOMATION - Identify opportunities to automate reporting - Integrate AI-driven analytics where appropriate QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of FP&A experience - Experience in SaaS, services, holding companies, or venture environments - Strong financial modeling skills - Advanced Excel/Sheets capabilities - Experience with QuickBooks data environments preferred - High communication skills — able to partner with founder-CEOs WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - BUs have clear financial visibility and forecasting accuracy - Hiring and investment decisions are grounded in strong modeling - Finance is seen as a growth enabler, not a reporting function

The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
